module-1/index.title: Module 1: Foundations of Physical AI & Embodied Intelligence
module-1/index.description: This module introduces the motivation, principles, and system-level thinking behind Physical AI. You'll explore the transition from digital AI to physical systems and understand why humanoid form factors matter in research and development.

module-2/chapter-1.title: The Robotic Nervous System (ROS 2)
module-2/chapter-1.description: Understanding the architecture and components of ROS 2 as the nervous system of robotic systems

module-2/chapter-2.title: Nodes, Topics, Services, and Actions
module-2/chapter-2.description: Understanding the fundamental communication patterns in ROS 2

module-2/chapter-3.title: Digital Robot Bodies (URDF & SDF)
module-2/chapter-3.description: Understanding how robots are represented digitally using URDF and SDF formats

module-2/index.title: Module 2: The Robotic Nervous System & Digital Body
module-2/index.description: This module explains how robots are structured internally and coordinated through software. You'll learn about ROS 2 architecture and how digital robot bodies are represented using URDF and SDF formats.

module-3/chapter-1.title: Simulation & Digital Twins
module-3/chapter-1.description: Understanding how simulation and digital twins support robot development and testing

module-3/chapter-2.title: Sensors & Perception Systems
module-3/chapter-2.description: Understanding how robots perceive their environment and extract meaningful information

module-3/chapter-3.title: The AI Robot Brain (Isaac Ecosystem)
module-3/chapter-3.description: Understanding NVIDIA's Isaac ecosystem for robotics AI and intelligent systems

module-3/index.title: Module 3: Simulation, Perception & the AI Robot Brain
module-3/index.description: This module explains how robots perceive, learn, and reason safely using simulation and AI platforms. You'll explore how robots understand their environment and make intelligent decisions.

module-4/chapter-1.description: Understanding systems that can operate at different levels of autonomy

module-4/chapter-2.title: Autonomous Robotics Applications
module-4/chapter-2.description: Understanding real-world applications of autonomous robotics systems

module-4/chapter-3.title: Integration & Coordination
module-4/chapter-3.description: Understanding how different robotic systems work together in complex environments

module-4/index.title: Module 4: Intelligence in Action — VLA & Autonomous Systems
module-4/index.description: This module explores practical implementations where all previous learning comes together in real systems. You'll learn about Variable Level of Autonomy and autonomous robotics applications.
